MENU_QUICK_DESC: Mayiko awiri aliwonse, bwalo lililonse. Centre pass ndi yanu.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Mayiko asanu ndi atatu, magulu awiri, semi-final ndi fainolo.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Bwalo, maudindo asanu ndi awiri ndi lamulo lililonse limene oyimbira amaimba.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Masewera enieni ndi makota anayi a mphindi 15. Nthawi siimaima chigoli chikalowa; imaima pokhapokha wina wavulala.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Lamulo la ligi: mphindi zisanu zomaliza za kota iliyonse, chigoli chochokera pa 3 m kapena kupitirira chimakhala mapointi awiri.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Otchinga awo amachedwa kuzindikira mapasi anu ndipo sakonda kuwalanda.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Timu yabwino ya kalabu: idzalanda pasi yofooka.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Timu ya padziko lonse: imazindikira masewera msanga, ndipo n'kovuta kuipasirana.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Abwino kwambiri padziko lonse. Pasi iliyonse yaulesi imalandidwa.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Mumasewera ndi wosewera amene ali ndi mpira, komanso wotchinga woyandikira mpirawo.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Timu: mumalamulira wosewera amene ali ndi mpira. Udindo umodzi: sankhani bib pa sikirini yoyamba ndipo musewere naye masewera onse, monga amachitira wosewera weniweni.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Yayatsa: wosewera wanu amaima m'mphepete mwa malo amene udindo wake umaloledwa. Yazimitsa: mukadutsa mzere, woyimbira amaimba offside.
POS_ROLE_GS: Amagoletsa zigoli ali pafupi ndi ndodo.
POS_ROLE_GA: Amagoletsa, amapereka mpira kwa GS ndipo amathamangira m'gawo lapakati.
POS_ROLE_WA: Amapereka mpira m'chozungulira kuchokera m'mphepete mwake; njira yoyamba pa centre pass.
POS_ROLE_C: Amatenga centre pass ndipo amalumikiza chitetezo ndi kuukira pa bwalo lonse.
POS_ROLE_WD: Amalondera WA ndipo amadula mapasi olowa m'chozungulira.
POS_ROLE_GD: Amalondera GA, m'chozungulira ndi kunja kwake.
POS_ROLE_GK: Amalondera GS, amateteza chigoli ndipo amatenga mpira wobwerera.
POS_AREAS_GS: Malo: gawo lakuukira ndi chozungulira cha chigoli.
POS_AREAS_GA: Malo: gawo lapakati, gawo lakuukira ndi chozungulira cha chigoli.
POS_AREAS_WA: Malo: gawo lapakati ndi gawo lakuukira, osati chozungulira.
POS_AREAS_C: Malo: magawo onse atatu, osati chozungulira chilichonse.
POS_AREAS_WD: Malo: gawo lapakati ndi gawo lodzitchinjiriza, osati chozungulira.
POS_AREAS_GD: Malo: gawo lapakati, gawo lodzitchinjiriza ndi chozungulira cha chigoli.
POS_AREAS_GK: Malo: gawo lodzitchinjiriza ndi chozungulira cha chigoli.
GFX_NOTE: Otsika ndi abwino pa mafoni otsika mtengo: palibe mizere, khamu laling'ono. Zodzisintha zikayatsidwa, masewera oyenda pang'onopang'ono m'masekondi oyamba amatsika mlingo okha.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Pafupifupi mafelemu {n} pa sekondi, ang'onoko pang'ono: foni siitentha ndipo batire imakhalitsa.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Mafelemu {n} pa sekondi pa sikirini yanu ya {hz} Hz: akuyenda bwino, ndipo amasunga batire kuposa ochuluka.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Mafelemu ochuluka monga momwe sikirini yanu ya {hz} Hz ingasonyezere.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Kokani batani lililonse kupita kumene chala chanu chachikulu chimalipeza. Adzakhala pomwepo.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Awa ndi masewera odziyimira pawokha. Matimu ndi mayiko omwe ali ndi mayina awo wamba; dzina la wosewera aliyense ndi lopeka. Sagwirizana ndi bungwe lililonse loyang'anira, ligi kapena mpikisano.
LICENCES_INTRO: Masewerawa apangidwa ndi mapulogalamu aulere ndi otseguka. Malayisensi awo amapempha kuti zidziwitso izi ziwonetsedwe; zili m'Chingerezi, monga zinalembedwera.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Kutalika 30.5 m ndi m'lifupi 15.25 m, logawidwa magawo atatu. Pakati pali chozungulira cha 0.9 m, ndipo kumapeto kulikonse kuli chozungulira cha chigoli: theka la bwalo la 4.9 m kuchokera ku ndodo. Mphete ili pamwamba pa 3.05 m, yopanda bolodi.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Wosewera aliyense amavala bib yosonyeza udindo wake, ndipo amalowa m'malo a udindo wakewo okha. Timu ikhoza kulemba osewera mpaka 12; kusintha kumachitika pa nthawi yopuma, chigoli chikalowa ngati zapemphedwa, ndiponso wina akavulala.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: GS ndi GA okha ndi omwe angagoletse, ndipo ali mkati mwa chozungulira cha chigoli. Mpira uyenera kudutsa mu mphete yonse. Kuponya komwe kwachoka m'manja mwake woyimbira asanaimbe muluzu kumawerengedwa.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Kota iliyonse imayamba ndi centre pass, chimodzimodzinso masewera chigoli chilichonse chikalowa. Matimu amasinthana, mosasamala kanthu kuti wagoletsa ndi ndani. C amaima m'chozungulira chapakati; ena amadikira m'magawo awo a chigoli mpaka muluzu, ndipo pasi iyenera kugwiridwa m'gawo lapakati.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Makota anayi a mphindi 15, ndi mphindi 4 pakati pa yoyamba ndi yachiwiri, ndi pakati pa yachitatu ndi yachinayi, ndi mphindi 12 pa hafu. Matimu amasinthana mbali kota iliyonse.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Ngati masewera ayenera kukhala ndi wopambana koma matimu ali ofanana: mahafu awiri a mphindi mpaka 7 ndi mphindi imodzi pakati pawo, kenako masewera amapitirira mpaka timu imodzi itatsogola ndi zigoli ziwiri.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Ali ndi mpira saloledwa kuthamanga. Phazi limene watera nalo ndi phazi lake lotera: akhoza kuponda ndi linalo ndi kuzungulira pa ilo, koma akangolikweza ayenera kupereka kapena kuponya lisanakhudzenso pansi. Pasi yaulere kwa timu inayo.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Ayenera kupereka kapena kuponya pasanathe masekondi atatu atagwira mpira. Held ball: pasi yaulere.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Wotchinga amene akufuna kutseka kapena kulanda mpira ayenera kuima osachepera 0.9 m kuchokera ku phazi lotera la wosewera amene ali ndi mpira. Akayandikira kuposa pamenepo, ndi kutsekereza (obstruction): pasi ya chilango.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Palibe kukhudzana kosokoneza masewera a wotsutsana naye: kukankha, kugwira, kumenya mpira m'manja mwake, kapena kusapatsa malo otera wosewera amene walanda mpira. Pasi ya chilango.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Wosewera amene walowa m'malo amene udindo wake suloledwa, ali ndi mpira kapena ayi, ndi offside. Mizere ndi gawo la malo amene imazungulira. Pasi yaulere.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Mpira suyenera kuponyedwa kudutsa gawo lonse popanda wosewera wa m'gawolo kuugwira kapena kuukhudza. Pasi yaulere.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Payenera kukhala malo oti wotsutsana alande mpira pakati pa woponya ndi wogwira. Pasi yaulere.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Mpira womwe wagwera kunja kwa bwalo umapita ku timu yomwe sinaukhudze komaliza: throw-in kuchokera pamene unadutsa mzere, mkati mwa masekondi atatu.
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Pasi yaulere imaperekedwa pamene cholakwa chinachitikira, ndi wosewera aliyense woloredwa kukhala pamenepo. Pa pasi ya chilango, wosewera wolangidwayo amaima pambali pa woponya, osasewera, mpaka mpira utaponyedwa. M'chozungulira cha chigoli, chilango chikhoza kukhala pasi kapena kuponya.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Woyimbira amalola masewera kupitirira ngati kuwaimitsa kungapweteke timu yomwe yalakwiridwa: mwachitsanzo, GS yemwe watsala pang'ono kuponya. Amalengeza mwayi ndi cholakwacho.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Chifukwa cha masewera obwerezabwereza kapena oopsa, woyimbira akhoza kuchenjeza wosewera, kumuimitsa kwa mphindi ziwiri za nthawi yamasewera, kapena kumutulutsa. Kuyambira 2024 palibe toss-up: osewera awiri akalakwira nthawi imodzi, timu yomwe inali ndi mpira komaliza imasunga mpirawo.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Maligi ena amasewera mosiyanako. Masewerawa ali ndi Double Zone: mphindi zisanu zomaliza za kota iliyonse, chigoli chochokera pa 3 m kapena kupitirira kuchokera ku ndodo chimakhala mapointi awiri.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Chala chachikulu chakumanzere paliponse kumanzere kwa sikirini ndi joystick: chimayendetsa wosewera wanu (mphete yobiriwira). Thamangirani pamalo opanda anthu kuti mulandire pasi.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Ali ndi mpira sangathamange. Kankhirani joystick kwa mnzake kuti mumusankhe (mphete imasonyeza kuti ndi ndani), kenako PEREKA kuti mupereke pa chifuwa kapena pa phewa, kapena KWEZA kuti mudutse pamwamba pa wotchinga. Mphete pamwamba pa mpira ndi masekondi anu atatu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: PONYA imaoneka GS kapena GA wanu ali ndi mpira m'chozungulira. Akakhala pafupi n'kosavuta; mkono wa wotchinga pamwamba pa mpira umavutitsa.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: TETEZA imakweza manja anu pamwamba pa mpira. Onani mphete yozungulira phazi lake lotera: yobiriwira ndi yovomerezeka, yofiira ndi yoyandikira kuposa 0.9 m ndipo woyimbira adzaimba kutsekereza.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: LANDA imadumphira pasi yomwe ili mlengalenga ngati mungaifikire pa nthawi. Mukadziponya kwa wosewera amene wagwira mpira, ndiye kukhudzana.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Mukamasewera ngati timu, mumalamulira wosewera amene ali ndi mpira, ndipo SINTHA imakusamutsirani kwa wotchinga woyandikira mpirawo. Sankhani bib pa sikirini yoyamba kuti musewere udindo umodzi masewera onse.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD kapena mivi kuti muyende, Space pa batani loyamba, J ndi K pa enawo, Esc kuti muimitse.
INTERVAL_NOTE: Nthawi yopuma ndi mphindi {min}; Pitirizani iyamba {next} tsopano.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Dinani udindo kuti mulowetse wosewera wotsatira pa benchi amene amasewera udindowo.
CUP_ABOUT: Mayiko asanu ndi atatu oyandikana ndi lanu pa mndandanda wa dziko lonse, m'magulu awiri a anayi. Awiri apamwamba pa gulu lililonse amapita ku semi-final; kenako fainolo ndi masewera a bronze. Mapointi awiri pakupambana, limodzi pofanana; ofanana amasiyanitsidwa ndi peresenti ya zigoli.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Sewerani masewera ndipo mbiri yanu iyamba pano.
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Lamulo la ligi: timu iliyonse ikhoza kupempha ma time-out awiri a masekondi 90 pa hafu iliyonse, chigoli chikalowa. Lanu lili mu menyu yoimitsa.
ROLLING_NOTE: Lamulo la ligi: sinthani osewera nthawi iliyonse kuchokera mu menyu yoimitsa, osati pa nthawi yopuma yokha.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Masekondi 90, nthawi itaimitsidwa. Sinthani osewera tsopano; Pitirizani mukakonzeka.
INJURY_NOTE: Wosewera wa {team} wavulala. Timu ili ndi masekondi 30 kuti imuthandize kutuluka; matimu onse awiri akhoza kusintha osewera. Pitirizani mukakonzeka.
UMP_FEWER_NOTE: Osewera enawo amalakwitsa theka la zolakwa zanthawi zonse.
UMP_STANDARD_NOTE: Pafupifupi gawo limodzi mwa atatu la zolakwa za masewera apamwamba, kuti masewera aziyenda.
UMP_REAL_NOTE: Zolakwa zambiri ngati masewera apamwamba: pafupifupi 50 timu iliyonse m'mphindi 60.
COACH_TIPS_NOTE: Malangizo afupiafupi pa masewera, lililonse koyamba mukalifuna. Amazimitsidwa mukamaliza masewera anu oyamba athunthu.
COACH_MOVE: Yendani ndi joystick yakumanzere. Mukusewera amene ali ndi mphete yobiriwira; zilembo pa bib yake zimanena kumene angapite.
COACH_PASS: Muli ndi mpira: simungathamange nawo, ndipo muyenera kupereka pasanathe masekondi atatu. Dinani {pass} kuponya ku mphete ya madontho, kapena choyamba lozani munthu ndi joystick.
COACH_SHOOT: Muli m'chozungulira cha chigoli: dinani {shoot}. Mukakhala pafupi ndi ndodo, n'kosavuta kugoletsa.
COACH_FOOTWORK: Mutagwira mpira mumaima: joystick imangokutembenuzani. {lob} imayandamitsa mpira pamwamba pa wotchinga wamtali.
COACH_DEFEND: Iwo ali ndi mpira. Thamangirani wosewera ndi kumulondera. {defend} imakweza manja anu, koma khalani 0.9 m kumbuyo: mphete imafiira mukayandikira kwambiri.
COACH_INTERCEPT: Pasi ili mlengalenga: dinani {intercept} kuidumphira. {switch} imakusamutsirani kwa mnzanu woyandikira mpira.
COACH_WHISTLE: Muluzu: chikwangwani chapamwamba chimanena chifukwa chake, ndi timu imene ili ndi mpira tsopano.
COACH_AREAS: Udindo uliwonse uli ndi malo ake m'bwalo: mukatulukamo ndi offside. 'Momwe mungasewerere' ili ndi mamapu.
MENU_LEAGUE_DESC: Makalabu asanu ndi atatu, marawundi asanu ndi awiri, kenako mafainolo.
LEAGUE_ABOUT: Makalabu asanu ndi atatu a ku Australia, New Zealand, England ndi South Africa amasewerana kamodzi. Anayi apamwamba amapita ku mafainolo: woyamba amasewera ndi wachinayi, wachiwiri ndi wachitatu, ndipo opambana amakumana mu fainolo yaikulu. Mapointi awiri pakupambana, limodzi pofanana; ofanana amasiyanitsidwa ndi peresenti ya zigoli.
LEAGUE_OUT: Kalabu yanu sinafike ku mafainolo. Mafainolo akupitirira popanda inu.
